title: Machine learning and single cell RNA sequencing analysis identifies regeneration-related hepatocytes and highlights a Birc5-related model for identifying cell proliferative ability.
authors: Du, Yuan; Jian, Shuqin; Wang, Xicheng; Yang, Chao; Qiu, Hua; Fang, Kang; Yan, Yehong; Shi, Jun; Li, Jianfeng
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习分析单细胞RNA测序数据鉴定肝再生相关肝细胞及Birc5基因签名，虽涉及转录因子Hmgb1但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Partial hepatectomy (PHx) has been shown to induce rapid regeneration of adult liver under emergency conditions. Therefore, an in-depth investigation of the underlying mechanisms that govern liver regeneration following PHx is crucial for a comprehensive understanding of this process. METHOD: We analyzed scRNA-seq data from liver samples of normal and PHx-48-hour mice. Seven machine learning algorithms were utilized to screen and validate a gene signature that accurately identifies and predicts this population. Co-immunostaining of zonal markers with BIRC5 to investigate regional characteristics of hepatocytes post-PHx. RESULTS: Single cell sequencing results revealed a population of regeneration-related hepatocytes. Transcription factor analysis emphasized the importance of Hmgb1 transcription factor in liver regeneration. HdWGCNA and machine learning algorithm screened and obtained the key signature characterizing this population, including a total of 17 genes and the function enrichment analysis indicated their high correlation with cell cycle pathway. It is note-worthy that we inferred that Hmgb1 might be vital in the regeneration-related hepatocytes of PHx_48h group. Parallelly, Birc5 might be closely related to the regulation of liver regeneration, and positively correlated with Hmgb1. CONCLUSIONS: Our study has identified a distinct population of hepatocytes that are closely associated with liver regeneration. Through machine learning algorithms, we have identified a set of 17 genes that are highly indicative of the regenerative capacity of hepatocytes. This gene signature has enabled us to assess the proliferation ability of in vitro cultured hepatocytes using sequencing data alone.
abstract_zh: 背景：部分肝切除术（PHx）已被证明可在紧急情况下诱导成年肝脏快速再生。因此，深入探究PHx后调控肝脏再生的潜在机制，对于全面理解该过程至关重要。方法：我们分析了正常和PHx后48小时小鼠肝脏样本的scRNA-seq数据。利用七种机器学习算法筛选并验证了一个能够准确识别和预测该细胞群体的基因特征。通过区域标志物与BIRC5的共免疫染色，研究PHx后肝细胞的区域特性。结果：单细胞测序结果揭示了一群与再生相关的肝细胞。转录因子分析强调了Hmgb1转录因子在肝脏再生中的重要性。HdWGCNA和机器学习算法筛选并获得了表征该群体的关键基因特征，共包含17个基因，功能富集分析表明这些基因与细胞周期通路高度相关。值得注意的是，我们推断Hmgb1可能在PHx_48h组的再生相关肝细胞中至关重要。同时，Birc5可能与肝脏再生的调控密切相关，并与Hmgb1呈正相关。结论：我们的研究识别出了一群与肝脏再生密切相关的独特肝细胞。通过机器学习算法，我们确定了一组包含17个基因的特征，这些基因高度指示肝细胞的再生能力。该基因特征使我们能够仅利用测序数据评估体外培养肝细胞的增殖能力。
